arxiv-2102-10036.title: Exact steady state of the open X ​ X XX -spin chain: entanglement and transport properties
arxiv-2102-10036.creator: F. Benatti, R. Floreanini, L. Memarzadeh
arxiv-2102-10036.description: Abstract We study the reduced dynamics of open quantum spin chains of arbitrary length N N with nearest neighbour X ​ X XX interactions, immersed within an external constant magnetic field along the z z direction, whose end spins are weakly coupled to heat baths at different temperatures, via energy preserving couplings.

arxiv-2210-12551.title: THE SCHWARZ ALTERNATING METHOD FOR THE SEAMLESS COUPLING OF NONLINEAR REDUCED ORDER MODELS AND FULL ORDER MODELS
arxiv-2210-12551.creator: Joshua Barnett, Irina Tezaur, Alejandro Mota
arxiv-2210-12551.description: Abstract Projection-based model order reduction allows for the parsimonious representation of full order models (FOMs), typically obtained through the discretization of a set of partial differential equations (PDEs) using conventional techniques (e.g., finite element, finite volume, finite difference methods) where the discretization may contain a very large number of degrees of freedom.

arxiv-2309-03604.title: Estimating the Coverage Measure and the Area Explored by a Line-Sweep Sensor on the Plane PubID: pubid:
arxiv-2309-03604.creator: Maria Costa Vianna, Eric Goubault, Luc Jaulin, Sylvie Putot
arxiv-2309-03604.description: Abstract This paper presents a method for determining the area explored by a line-sweep sensor during an area-covering mission in a two-dimensional plane. Accurate knowledge of the explored area is crucial for various applications in robotics, such as mapping, surveillance, and coverage optimization.

arxiv-2402-14752.title: Limitations and Separations in the Quantum Sum-of-squares, and the Quantum Knapsack Problem
arxiv-2402-14752.creator: Matthew B. Hastings
arxiv-2402-14752.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matthew B. Hastings. We answer two questions regarding the sum-of-squares for the SYK model left open in Hastings and O’Donnell 2022 , both of which are related to graphs. First (a “limitation”), we show that a fragment of the sum-of-squares, in which one considers commutation relations of degree- 4 4 Majorana operators but does not impose any other relations on them, does not give the correct order of magnitude bound on the ground state energy.

arxiv-2409-00181.title: On the smallness of charm loop effects in B → K ( ∗ ) ​ ℓ ​ ℓ B\to K^{(*)}\ell\ell at low q 2 q^{2} : light meson Distribution Amplitude analysis
arxiv-2409-00181.creator: Namit Mahajan, Dayanand Mishra
arxiv-2409-00181.description: Abstract The non-local effects originating from the charm quark loops at dilepton invariant masses smaller than the charmonium threshold in B → K ​ ℓ ​ ℓ B\to K\ell\ell are evaluated with light meson distribution amplitudes. The revised estimates with B-meson distribution amplitude within a Light Cone Sum Rule approach yielded results about three orders smaller than the original computation.

arxiv-2409-07715.title: FIReStereo: Forest InfraRed Stereo Dataset for UAS Depth Perception in Visually Degraded Environments
arxiv-2409-07715.creator: Devansh Dhrafani, Yifei Liu, Andrew Jong, Ukcheol Shin, Yao He, Tyler Harp, Yaoyu Hu, Jean Oh, Sebastian Scherer
arxiv-2409-07715.description: Abstract Robust depth perception in visually-degraded environments is crucial for autonomous aerial systems. Thermal imaging cameras, which capture infrared radiation, are robust to visual degradation. However, due to lack of a large-scale dataset, the use of thermal cameras for unmanned aerial system (UAS) depth perception has remained largely unexplored.

arxiv-2412-16564.title: Predictive Monitoring of Black-Box Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2412-16564.creator: Thomas A. Henzinger, Fabian Kresse, Kaushik Mallik, Emily Yu, Đorđe Žikelić
arxiv-2412-16564.description: Abstract We study the problem of predictive runtime monitoring of black-box dynamical systems with quantitative safety properties. The black-box setting stipulates that the exact semantics of the dynamical system and the controller are unknown, and that we are only able to observe the state of the controlled (aka, closed-loop) system at finitely many time points.

arxiv-2503-15359.title: Engineering interaction potentials for stabilizing quantum quasicrystal phases
arxiv-2503-15359.creator: Matheus Grossklags, Daniel Lima, Vinicius Zampronio, Fabio Cinti, Alejandro Mendoza-Coto
arxiv-2503-15359.description: Abstract We investigate the necessary features of the pair interaction for the stabilization of self-assembled quantum quasicrystals in two-dimensional bosonic systems. Unlike the classical scenario, our results show that two-dimensional octagonal, decagonal, and dodecagonal aperiodic phases require a distinct number of properly tuned characteristic length scales for their stabilization.

arxiv-2506-13161.title: Using LLMs for Security Advisory Investigations: How Far Are We?
arxiv-2506-13161.creator: 1 st Bayu Fedra Abdullah, 4 th Raula Gaikovina Kula, 2 nd Yusuf Sulistyo Nugroho, 5 th Kazumasa Shimari, 3 rd Brittany Reid, 6 th Kenichi Matsumoto
arxiv-2506-13161.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software security, but their trustworthiness in generating accurate vulnerability advisories remains uncertain. This study investigates the ability of ChatGPT to (1) generate plausible security advisories from CVE-IDs, (2) differentiate real from fake CVE-IDs, and (3) extract CVE-IDs from advisory descriptions.

arxiv-2509-07974.title: Towards an application of fourth-order shear statistics II
arxiv-2509-07974.creator: Lucas Porth, 1 Elena Silvestre-Rosello, 2,1 Peter Schneider 1, Martina Larma 1
arxiv-2509-07974.description: Abstract Context. Higher-order lensing statistics contain a wealth of cosmological information that is not captured by second-order statistics. Stage-III lensing surveys have sufficient statistical power to significantly detect cumulant-based statistics up to fourth order. Aims. We derive and validate an efficient estimation procedure for the four-point correlation function (4PCF) of polar fields such as weak lensing shear.

arxiv-2511-18340.title: Curvature Perturbations from Higgs Modulated Reheating
arxiv-2511-18340.creator: Weiyi Deng 1, Chengcheng Han 1,2, Zhanhong Lei 1, Jin Min Yang 3,4
arxiv-2511-18340.description: Abstract In this work we investigate curvature perturbations and non-Gaussianity arising from Higgs modulated reheating in the early Universe. We employ three different methods — the period-averaging (PA) method, the exact method, and the non-perturbative δ ​ N \delta N formalism — to compute the power spectrum and bispectrum of curvature perturbations.

britannica-1911-humphrey-lawrence.title: Humphrey, Lawrence (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-humphrey-lawrence.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-humphrey-lawrence.description: Article 'Humphrey, Lawrence' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 13), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. president of Magdalen College, Oxford, and dean successively of Gloucester and Winchester, was born at Newport Pagnel. He was elected demy of Magdalen College in 1546 and fellow in 1548. He was noted as one of the most promising pupils of Peter Martyr, and on Mary’s accession obtained leave from his college to travel abroad.

pmc-11480938.title: Enzymatically Triggered Drug Release from Microgels Controlled by Glucose Concentration
pmc-11480938.creator: Klaudia Kaniewska, Marcin Mackiewicz, Oleh Smutok, Mykhailo Gonchar, Evgeny Katz, Marcin Karbarz
pmc-11480938.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study aims to design microgels for controlled drug release via enzymatically generated pH changes in the presence of glucose. Modern medicine is focused on developing smart delivery systems with controlled release capabilities. In response to this demand, we present the synthesis, characterization, and enzymatically triggered drug release behavior of microgels based on poly(acrylic acid) modified with glucose oxidase (GOx) (p(AA-BIS)-GOx). TEM images revealed that the sizes of air-dried p(AA-BIS)-GOx microgels were approximately 130 nm.

pmc-12473140.title: Oral Microbiota Dysbiosis in Male HIV Patients: Comparative Analysis of Candidiasis and HPV-Associated Lesions
pmc-12473140.creator: Magnolia del Carmen Ramírez-Hernández, Javier Gaytán-Cervantes, Carolina González-Torres, Miguel Ángel Loyola-Cruz, Rebeca Eunice García-Mendiola, Clemente Cruz-Cruz, Iliana Alejandra Cortés-Ortíz, Eduardo García-Moncada, Teresa López-Flores, Emilio Mariano Durán-Manuel, Nancy Gómez-Mancilla, María
pmc-12473140.description: Progressive immune damage associated with Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) alters mucosal homeostasis, favouring oral microbial imbalance and the development of opportunistic infections. The aim of this study was to characterize the composition and structure of the oral microbiota in different clinical conditions of HIV infection.

pmc-12649293.title: From Gender Threat to Farsightedness: How Women’s Perceived Intergroup Threat Shapes Their Long-Term Orientation
pmc-12649293.creator: Yongheng Shi, Yufang Zhao, Xingyang Ma, Shasha Chen, Phillip Ozimek
pmc-12649293.description: Women experience realistic and symbolic gender intergroup threats across diverse social contexts, which can profoundly influence their decision-making processes. Drawing on intergroup threat theory, this research investigated how perceived gender intergroup threats affect women’s intertemporal choice behavior and examined cognitive appraisal as a potential mediating mechanism.

pmc-13081023.title: Acute Appendicitis Presenting as Mechanical Small Bowel Obstruction in a Patient With Prior Abdominal Surgery: A Diagnostic Dilemma
pmc-13081023.creator: Nehemia I Kassa, Filagot B Mikru, Yared Wasihun, Bewuketu Kefyalew, Bethel D Demissie
pmc-13081023.description: Acute appendicitis is a common surgical emergency. However, its atypical presentations, such as mechanical small bowel obstruction (SBO), are exceedingly rare and diagnostically challenging. This is particularly true in patients with prior abdominal surgery, where postoperative adhesion is the most clinically significant cause.

pmc-13106106.title: Interrater Reliability of the Ankylosing Spondylitis Performance Index in Patients With Axial Spondyloarthritis
pmc-13106106.creator: Christopher Alexander Rasmussen, Sebastian Bülow Mink, Jette Primdahl, Kirsten Lykke Knak
pmc-13106106.description: IntroductionIn recent years, the Ankylosing Spondylitis Performance Index (ASPI) has emerged as a new objective measure of physical function in patients with axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA). So far, only the relative interrater reliability of the ASPI test has been reported, but the absolute interrater reliability remains to be investigated.

pmc-13140773.title: Standardization of the Cirrhosis Admission Process and Its Impact on Inpatient Management and Patient Outcomes
pmc-13140773.creator: Laura E. Lavette, Hannah Laird, Ashley Chipoletti, Mira Sridharan, Jessica J. Dreicer, Andrew Barros, Zachary Henry
pmc-13140773.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionAn increase in cirrhosis‐related hospitalizations has highlighted opportunities for improved patient care and standardization of practice. We created a cirrhosis admission order set with the goal of promoting guideline‐directed care and improving patient outcomes.MethodsWe developed and implemented a cirrhosis order set that included dietary recommendations, diagnostic paracentesis orders and studies, common complications of portal hypertension and educational materials at time of discharge.

pmc-13441900.title: Adolescent multi-omics and Mendelian randomization reveal transdiagnostic molecular mechanisms in psychiatric disorders
pmc-13441900.creator: Luheng Qian, Runye Shi, Xinyang Yu, Di Chen, Tobias Banaschewski, Arun L. W. Bokde, Herta Flor, Antoine Grigis, Hugh Garavan, Penny Gowland, Andreas Heinz, Jean-Luc Martinot, Marie-Laure Paillère Martinot, Eric Artiges, Frauke Nees, Dimitri Papadopoulos Orfanos, Luise Poustka, Sarah Hohmann, Nathali
pmc-13441900.description: The biological mechanisms underlying major neuropsychiatric disorders remain largely elusive. Given the frequent association of immune dysregulation with these conditions, we used blood-derived multi-omics data from 1,274 healthy adolescents in the IMAGEN cohort to identify transdiagnostic biomarkers and mechanisms that could inform diagnosis and treatment.

pmc-13599546.title: Clinical biochemical significance of STAT6, ERG, and miR-647 expression in prostate cancer: Associations with tumor aggressiveness and patient prognosis
pmc-13599546.creator: Xin Hong, Lin Zhao, Tian Wang, Xiaobing Yang, Changzhen Hao
pmc-13599546.description: BackgroundReliable molecular indicators that can facilitate early detection and prognosis prediction in prostate cancer are still insufficient. Although Transcription 6 (STAT6), ERG, and microRNA-647 (miR-647) have recently been recognized as key participants in tumor-related signaling pathways, their specific biochemical functions in the context of prostate cancer have yet to be clearly defined.
